data.legalName: Annapurna Sweets and Snacks Private Limited
data.summary: Fully onboarded (synthetic demo merchant). Settlement Agent is monitoring this merchant.

timeline.title: Application submitted
timeline.detail: Onboarded and activated (synthetic demo merchant; Stage 10, Live Unlimited).

timeline.title: Settlement Agent is monitoring
timeline.detail: Loaded 32 days of settlement history (synthetic, about ₹40,000 a day). The agent compares every 48 hours with the trailing 30-day baseline.

timeline.title: Settlement Agent · MONITOR
timeline.detail: Compared the last 48 hours (2026-10-01 to 2026-10-02) with the trailing 30-day baseline. Volume ₹7,12,588 a day against ₹42,584 a day (1673% of baseline, threshold 150%). Settlement expected ₹14,07,622, actual ₹7,82,842, 44.4% apart (threshold 10%). ANOMALY DETECTED: velocity anomaly and settlement anomaly.

timeline.title: Settlement Agent · RECONCILE
timeline.detail: Expected ₹14,07,622, actual ₹7,82,842: difference ₹6,24,780 (44.4%). ₹4,29,780 sits in held batch B-20261001-B, B-20261002-B (9 payments); ₹1,95,000 was debited as 4 chargebacks. 32 payments are flagged as the likely cause.

timeline.title: Asked the case memory
timeline.detail: What did this merchant declare at onboarding about its business, expected turnover, outlet locations and payment terminals, and were there any risk notes or verification results?

timeline.title: Settlement Agent · INVESTIGATE
timeline.detail: Pulled the merchant's declared profile from the Cognee merchant twin (backend search). Attached 32 specific payments (₹13,40,000) as evidence.

timeline.title: Settlement Agent · CREATE CASE
timeline.detail: Opened investigation INV-30001 from the merchant's case KYB-20820. Recommended action: Hold the next settlement and verify the activity. Brief generated from the computed facts (template).

timeline.title: Settlement Agent · ESCALATE
timeline.detail: Placed INV-30001 in the KAM Needs Attention queue (route ESCALATE, due in 4 hours). The agent has not moved or held any money; a person decides.

timeline.title: Finding stored in the merchant twin
timeline.detail: Investigation INV-30001 was added to the merchant's Cognee dataset, so "Ask this case" can answer about it.
